metadata.title: FCE Gap-Fill - 15 Gaps
metadata.description: Open cloze with gap 0 as example. Gaps test grammar across the sentence: auxiliaries, passive, modals, conditionals, reported speech, relatives, linking words, gerunds and infinitives, phrasal verbs, fixed expressions, dependent prepositions, plus the determiners and comparisons the exam also tests. 'area' on each gap names it; a slash lists accepted alternatives.

exercises.text:

exercises.title: The Language of Flowers
exercises.text:

Yellow roses suggested jealousy, for example, while a red tulip was nothing {{3}} than a declaration of love.

A flower that meant 'I adore you' in one book might mean 'Leave me alone' in another, which must {{9}} led to some awkward misunderstandings. The way the flowers were presented mattered, {{10}}. {{11}} a bouquet was offered with the right hand, the answer was 'yes'; if it was offered with the left, it was 'no'.

exercises.text:
